Privacy.metaDescription: What data PlažaInfo collects, why it is processed, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: PlažaInfo is a free map of Adriatic beaches. This page explains which personal data we process, why and for how long. The service is run by a private individual, not a company; contact details are at the bottom of this page.
Privacy.dataIntro: You can use the app without signing in — the map, filters and beach details ask nothing of you. Data is created only when you submit something:
Privacy.dataAccount: Google account — when you sign in, Google gives us your email address, name and profile picture. Signing in is required for reviews, photos and beach submissions, because every contribution must have an author.
Privacy.dataContributions: Your contributions — your rating and review text, photos you upload, and the beach or parking details you submit. They are linked to your account.
Privacy.dataDevice: Device marker — when you report crowding, a random identifier stored in your browser (localStorage) is saved with the report. It does not reveal who you are; it only prevents the same person reporting the same beach ten times.
Privacy.dataLocation: Location — if you allow it, your browser gives us your coordinates so we can sort beaches by distance or let you drop a pin on the map. We do not store those coordinates. The exception is a crowd report: when the app asks for it, an approximate report location may be stored with it.
Privacy.dataTechnical: Technical data — to prevent abuse we count requests per visitor. We do not store your IP address: it is turned into an irreversible digest (SHA-256) used purely as a counter.
Privacy.purposeTitle: 2. Why we process it and on what basis
Privacy.purposeService: Publishing and displaying your contributions (reviews, photos, submissions) — performance of the service you asked for, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.
Privacy.purposeConsent: Location — solely on the basis of your consent, Art. 6(1)(a). You can withdraw it in your browser settings at any time.
Privacy.purposeLegitimate: Content moderation and protection against spam and abuse — legitimate interest in keeping the service usable, Art. 6(1)(f).
Privacy.retentionContributions: Published reviews, photos and beach data stay until you ask for deletion or the service shuts down — they are the content of the site.
Privacy.retentionRejected: Rejected submissions and photos are deleted when the moderation queue is cleaned up.
Privacy.retentionAccount: Account data is deleted on your request; your contributions are then either deleted or detached from their author, whichever you ask for.
Privacy.retentionTechnical: Request counters (the IP digest) live at most a few hours — the length of the rate-limit window.
Privacy.sharingIntro: We do not sell data and do not use it for advertising. Only these services process it on our behalf:
Privacy.sharingSupabase: Supabase — database, sign-in and photo storage.
Privacy.sharingGoogle: Google — Google account sign-in (only if you sign in).
Privacy.sharingMaps: OpenFreeMap — map tiles; their server sees your browser's requests for map sections.
Privacy.sharingLegal: Beyond that, we disclose data to third parties only when a competent authority requires it by law.
Privacy.cookiesBody: We have no analytics and no advertising cookies. We use only what the app cannot work without: the sign-in cookie (when you sign in) and browser local storage for the device marker and for remembering your location consent. Clearing site data in your browser removes them.
Privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to access your data, to rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, objection and portability. Ask by email from the address you signed in with and we will respond within 30 days.
Privacy.rightsAuthority: If you believe we process your data unlawfully, you can complain to the Croatian Personal Data Protection Agency (AZOP), Selska cesta 136, Zagreb.
Privacy.childrenBody: The service is not intended for people under 16 and we do not knowingly collect their data.
Privacy.changesBody: We may change this policy; the date of the last change is always at the top of the page. Significant changes will be announced in the app itself.
Privacy.contactBody: For any privacy question, write to {email}.

Terms.metaDescription: Rules for using PlažaInfo, rules for user contributions, data licensing and the copyright infringement procedure.
Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: By using PlažaInfo you accept these terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the service.
Terms.serviceTitle: 1. What PlažaInfo is and is not
Terms.serviceBody: PlažaInfo is a free informational service about beaches on the Croatian coast. The data is informational and may be inaccurate or out of date.
Terms.serviceSea: Sea quality is taken from the Institute of Oceanography and Fisheries (IZOR). It is sampled roughly every two weeks and is not a live measurement.
Terms.serviceCrowd: Crowding levels are visitor reports — unverified and unofficial.
Terms.serviceSafety: PlažaInfo is not a rescue service or a source of safety instructions. The decision to enter the sea and your own safety are yours alone, on site.
Terms.contributionsAuth: Reviews, photos and beach submissions require signing in with a Google account.
Terms.contributionsModeration: Everything you submit goes through moderation and is published only after review. We may reject content or remove it later.
Terms.contributionsRules: It is forbidden to submit offensive, unlawful, promotional or false content, other people's personal data, or photos in which other people are recognisable without their consent.
Terms.photosWarranty: By uploading a photo you warrant that you are its author or have the author's permission to publish it, and that publishing it infringes nobody's rights.
Terms.photosLicense: You keep the copyright to your photo. You grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free right to display it as part of PlažaInfo (including scaled-down versions and sharing a link to the beach page). That right ends when we remove the photo at your request.
Terms.photosRemoval: You can ask us by email to remove your photo at any time.
Terms.osmBody: Beach geometry, amenities and parking are derived from OpenStreetMap. © OpenStreetMap contributors — the data is available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
Terms.osmDerived: Derived data shown on these pages keeps the same licence. Map tiles are served by OpenFreeMap.
Terms.osmSources: Sea quality: IZOR. Weather and sea data: Open-Meteo.
Terms.copyrightBody: If you believe content on PlažaInfo infringes your copyright, write to {email}. We will remove or block the disputed content without delay once verified.
Terms.copyrightItem1: a link to the disputed content (the beach page URL and, if possible, the photo itself),
Terms.copyrightItem2: a description of the work whose rights are infringed and proof that you are the rights holder or their authorised agent,
Terms.copyrightItem4: a statement that your claims are accurate and that you are acting in good faith.
Terms.copyrightCounter: We will notify the user whose content is removed and allow them to object at the same address.
Terms.liabilityBody: The service is provided as is, without warranty of accuracy, availability or fitness for a particular purpose. To the extent permitted by law we are not liable for damage arising from reliance on data from PlažaInfo.
Terms.changesBody: We may amend these terms; the version published on this page, with the date at the top, applies. We may change or shut down the service at any time.
Terms.lawBody: Croatian law applies, and the court in Split has jurisdiction over disputes.
